summary: Archived Tracks 05, 06, 07 and 08 satisfy hard dependencies; archived Tracks 03 and 04 satisfy later governance dependencies. Work is generated-synthetic, local and no-model by default. Private data, model acquisition, training, compute spend, adapted-weight distribution, clinical claims and operational promotion remain gated.

The start record's acquisition gate is Track10-specific: earlier bounded Track05 comparator and Track08 local-adapter acquisitions did not authorise a new Track10 comparator, training, private-data use, adapted artefact, promotion or release.
